turns.replyTail: Message from Jen Small: A physical gift order cannot include a gift message or physical gift note. You can send a gift receipt separately using the Gift Receipt tool: 1. Enter the order number without the #, plus the associated postal code or email address. 2. Enter the recipient’s name and select the products to include. 3. Select Create Receipt to generate a QR code. 4. Share the QR code by email or print it for the recipient. Prices, discounts, and coupons won’t be shown on the gift receipt.
